{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Environment

|serverExec= server

|descr= Instantly set weather conditions and share it across network.

|s1= [strength, density, altitude] call [[BIS_fnc_setFog]]

|p1= strength: [[Number]] - fog strength from 0 to 1

|p2= density: [[Number]] - fog density from 0 to 1

|p3= altitude: [[Number]] - fog base altitude in metres.

|r1= [[Array]] - array with set values

|x1= <sqf>[1,1,100] call BIS_fnc_setFog; // returns [1,1,100]</sqf>

|seealso= [[setFog]] [[fog]]
}}
